findings.finding: Claude Code had the skill but no user-scope OpenSky MCP registration; Desktop had a legacy configuration not loaded by its running process.
findings.resolution: Registered Code through its CLI and installed/enabled a native Desktop extension without restarting active Claude sessions.

findings.finding: Opening the initial bundle from Documents timed out; the native file picker appeared late and its untitled window was omitted from normal app inventory.
findings.resolution: Verified outcomes before further input, discovered the exact app-owned window through OpenSky scripting and completed native selection. Setup-generated bundles live under the installed runtime, with a prefilled path and a nonblocking launch request.
findings.remainingGap: Untitled native picker discovery can still require a bounded OpenSky scripting observation.

findings.finding: The Desktop runtime directory form displayed an unexpanded ${HOME} placeholder and disabled Save.
findings.resolution: Configured the real path for the live installation. The portable bundle now accepts an optional custom path; the one-command helper prepares an absolute-path bundle without that form.

findings.finding: The MCP handshake advertised an older hard-coded version.
findings.resolution: Read the version from the installed package.

scope: Native Desktop installation was live-verified with the initial directory-form bundle. The later optional/preconfigured manifest variants have schema, packaging and fixture validation; the already-enabled real extension was reused.
The one-command existing-installation path was live-verified. A clean Mac first installation and every Claude interface have not been tested.
Desktop enabled-state detection reads local extension metadata and is separate from an actual connection check. Unknown layouts remain unverified; the helper never edits the extension registry.
The extension requires the installed macOS OpenSky engine. It is not a remote claude.ai connector, and normal macOS/Claude consent and host rules remain effective.
